_comment: TotalSegmentator v2 'total' task names -> Dataset810 one-shot names. Ribs 1-11 pool per side, rib 12 keeps its own class; TS has no L6, no T13, no thirteenth rib and no lumbar-rib class, so those are scored as misses and its rib-12/rib-11 calls on a lumbar rib show up in the rib confusion. sacrum and vertebrae_S1 union onto our whole-sacrum class; femora pool into the single femur class. Vertebrae above T10 and everything else go to background (their GT voxels are 'ignore' and excluded).
